quote: If the decision is made to be Inquire, the machine needs to ask a follow-up question to further clarify. Question generation in this part is mainly based on the uncovered information in the rule document, and then that information will be rephrased into a question.
Question generation ... we predict the position of an under‑specified span within a rule document ... then rephrase into a question.
In this work, we are interested in building a machine that can not only make the right decisions but also raise questions when necessary.
For question generation, the main metric is F1 BLEU proposed in , which calculates the BLEU scores for question generation when the predicted decision is 'inquire'.
